turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Then don't waste it. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Don't manage me, Hale. You still haven't answered whether Owen was heard first. What do you have besides that checker?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
Then why is there a zero next to my son's name? I'm writing down that you've had three chances to answer and haven't. Evidence, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
